title: BBP Transition for Deformed Inhomogeneous Random Matrices
summary: We study finite-rank deformations of inhomogeneous random symmetric/Hermitian matrices $H_N=(σ_{ij}W_{ij})_{i,j=1}^N$, whose variance profile satisfies $\sum_jσ_{ij}^2=1$.
